Description: Infection of susceptible humans by infectious mosquitoes through bites.
Progression of exposed humans to the infectious state after the incubation period.
Recovery of infectious humans, who then become immune.
Hatching of mosquito eggs into the larval stage.
Maturation of mosquito larvae into the pupal stage.
Emergence of adult female mosquitoes from the pupal stage.
Infection of susceptible mosquitoes by biting infectious humans.
Oviposition (egg laying) by susceptible adult female mosquitoes.

Name: Number of infectious bites delivered per vector per day
Description: Effective biting rate of vectors. The paper uses different values for two simulated locations.

Name: Human population growth rate
Description: Intrinsic growth rate for the human population, used in the logistic growth model.

Name: Carrying capacity for human population
Description: Maximum sustainable human population for the two simulated locations.

Name: Human incubation rate
Description: Rate at which exposed humans become infectious, corresponding to an incubation time of 3 days.

Name: Human recovery rate
Description: Rate at which infectious humans recover, corresponding to a recovery time of 7 days.

Name: Vector incubation rate
Description: Rate at which exposed vectors become infectious, corresponding to an incubation time of 10 days.

Name: Oviposition rate
Description: Number of eggs laid per female mosquito per day.

Name: Egg development rate
Description: Rate at which eggs develop into larvae, corresponding to a development time of 3 days.

Name: Natural egg mortality rate
Description: Natural mortality rate of mosquito eggs.

Name: Larval development rate
Description: Rate at which larvae develop into pupae, corresponding to a development time of 9 days.

Name: Natural larval mortality rate
Description: Natural mortality rate of mosquito larvae.

Name: Carrying capacity for larvae
Description: Maximum sustainable mosquito larvae population for the two simulated locations.

Name: Density-dependent larval mortality rate
Description: Additional mortality rate for larvae due to competition and limited carrying capacity.

Name: Pupal development rate
Description: Rate at which pupae develop into adults, corresponding to a development time of 3 days.

Name: Natural pupal mortality rate
Description: Natural mortality rate of mosquito pupae.

Name: Adult mosquito mortality rate
Description: Natural mortality rate of adult mosquitoes.

Name: Female adult percentage
Description: Proportion of emerging adult mosquitoes that are female.
